comments.author: @theplouf5533
comments.text:
It is rather interesting to see capitalism believe in its epic by literally building a giant door towards its end.

Seriously. If Tesla mines, produces (energy + tools) and produces all the needs on earth. Who will need employees? Who will make money and who will be able to buy these products? Unless they are the only last engineers in this business.

I am not afraid of communism, I have been participating for a long time in France, but it is the transition that scares me. During a certain interval, these companies will be able to literally suck up the economy without any "labour cost" constraint.
It’s a shift that people don’t understand.

They not only lower costs, but they actually completely remove the possibility of people being able to consume products through their labor.
